svg.title: What the first request carries
svg.desc: Two stacked bars on one scale. Claude Code's first request (42,583 tokens) is mostly tool definitions (24,803, of which 12,469 is one Artifact tool), then lists after the prompt (10,777) and the system prompt (4,332); Codex's (16,637 tokens) is mostly tool definitions (about 7,900) and base instructions (about 4,100).

g.text: Claude Code, first request: 42,583 tokens (measured; 32,602 in our closest-to-default setup)
Lists after the prompt: skills 6,204, deferred tool names 1,706, MCP server instructions 1,139,
Codex, first request: 16,637 tokens (measured total; parts estimated)
Claude Code parts measured with count_tokens. Codex tools and base instructions from cache counts,
the other Codex parts estimated from character counts. Both totals are measured.
Segments are grouped by type, not in request order.
